name: rally-pdk-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is Rally (`esrally`), the macrobenchmarking framework for Elasticsearch. A Rally
track describes a benchmark workload: its indices, data corpora and the challenges whose schedule of tasks Rally's
load driver runs against a cluster, with per-task clients, warmup, iterations, target throughput and schedulers,
and operation runners that issue the Elasticsearch requests and report their results.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is Rally's track and load-generation subsystem: the esrally/track/ package (track model, track loader and parameter sources), the esrally/driver/ package (load driver, operation runners and schedulers), the esrally/client/ package (Elasticsearch client factory and client wrappers), the esrally/tracker/ package (create-track), the esrally/utils/ package and the core modules esrally/__init__.py, esrally/_version.py, esrally/config.py, esrally/exceptions.py, esrally/paths.py, esrally/time.py, esrally/types.py and esrally/version.py, together with README.md, the documentation pages docs/track.rst, docs/advanced.rst, docs/adding_tracks.rst and docs/quickstart.rst, and the module, class and function docstrings of the in-scope modules.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation to make a disagreement go
